interfaces_exposed: deterministic prototype plus sparse residual plus canonical first-hit parity certificate
kill_condition: Retire general Route D if ideal syndrome materially exceeds direct rank, bounded search requires materially more parity than ideal, expansions grow exponentially from 64 through 256 bits, or the constructive payload fails to beat the causal control. promotion_condition: On frozen development and page-disjoint holdout, exact direct rank and bounded parity search both beat the same causal microblock control after all syndrome, mode, length, matrix, finalization, and source costs; candidate expansions remain within the fixed budget; offset transfer is positive before larger blocks.
retired_neighborhoods: general MOIRAI WRT inference and unrestricted whole-page energy search
title: Seal-2 Route D structural prototype residual microblocks
